title: plan_inputs.json
description: User inputs of one plan (K1, D52): what POST /jobs, POST /pads/screen, POST /plans/import, the plan library (plan_versions.inputs) and JSON export carry. Not the bundle's plan.json (contracts/bundle/plan.schema.json), which is the resolved plan identity built from these inputs and a result. Every omitted field takes its default from config (config/backend.yaml ranges, crew.yaml, conditions.yaml). Ranges, length caps and the number of user points are enforced by the server from config/backend.yaml, not here; this schema fixes structure and names only. The result hash is computed over the inputs AFTER defaults are filled (contracts/backend/README.md 'Result hash').
x-source: Backend spec §7, F24, F25, F26, F28; kit K1; D52; D97 (route, v1.2.0)

contract_version.description: backend contract family version the document was written against

title.description: free text, rendered as text; removed before hashing (a title never changes a result); cap: config/backend.yaml limits.title_max_chars

pad.description: Rover pad (F24). lon/lat in Mars 2000 planetocentric degrees (east positive), 6 decimals.

id.description: a pad id from scenarios/pads/index.json (the official pad is the entry with official: true) when the pad was picked; absent for a custom pad

crew.description: Custom crew and suit (F26). Ranges: config/backend.yaml ranges; defaults: crew.yaml.

start_lmst_h.description: EVA start, local mean solar time, hours

stations.description: Station choice (F25). best = exact DP over all stations (F9); set = fixed set in the best order; order = fixed order as given. v1.2.0: stops and their order are set with route (D97); mode set/order and custom stay cut (D69) and the server refuses them.

ids.description: station ids (stations.json) and user points; required for set and order

custom.description: user science points U1-U3 (F25 stretch); label 'user station · no science scoring'

route.description: Route (D97, v1.2.0). auto = the engine chooses stations and order (F9, as the official plan); ordered = legs pad -> stops[0] -> ... -> pad in exactly the given order, never reordered; an order that breaks a limit is answered with run_record.feasibility (feasible false), not refused. Missing route = auto. A stop is a station of stations.json ({station}) or a free point ({lon, lat, label?}); free points are named W1, W2, ... in their order among the free stops (run_record.feasibility from/to). Limits (config/backend.yaml route.max_stops, route.max_free_points, route.min_stop_spacing_m) and stop validity (inside the grid, assessed, walkable, reachable) are enforced by the server, which answers 422 naming the stop. Hash: a missing route or mode auto hashes as absent (v1.1 hashes unchanged); ordered hashes the stops in order with label removed (D57).

stops.description: the stops in visiting order; absent or empty for auto

label.description: free text, rendered as text; removed before hashing (D57); cap: config/backend.yaml limits.title_max_chars

conditions.description: Storm timing (F25, D39) and dose allowance (F26, D9).

tripwire_at.description: route_max_t_home (D39 default, conditions.yaml storm_replay.tripwire_at) or an EVA minute
